question: Does the Markov-order shift under transition recoding (DISC-001) replicate under a pre-registered design with new seeds and a family of sources?
purpose: Promote DISC-001 from post-hoc pattern to tested claim, or reject it.

question: Replace the 'spread' metric (F-002) with damage-support width and light-cone speed; rerun EXP-D.
purpose: Fix a rejected metric before building on damage measurements.

question: Next ladder rung: a tiny register machine (4 registers x 8 bits, ~8-instruction ISA) interpreter producing instruction traces with architectural state.
purpose: Move from abstract dynamics to register/instruction traces (charter §47).

question: Exhaustive fault injection into register-machine state; measure per-layer masking and compute ACE-style vulnerability per observable.
purpose: Test whether EXP-G findings (non-monotone distance, observable-relative masking) survive a less toy-like model.

question: Structural lifting: treat functional graphs on X_n as states and single-edge rewires as transitions; measure whether the lifted system has structure not predictable from level-0 statistics.
expected_information_gain: medium-high (could collapse to known random-graph-process theory)
required_resources: stdlib; small n (n<=4 bits: 16^16 graphs => must sample)

question: Operationalise the seven-stage question: for each boundary in the register-machine model, test congruence of the layer map and count where new measurable quantities appear.
Temporal structure beyond logical time: an asynchronous/event-driven model where inter-event intervals are part of the model, not the instrument.
purpose: Charter §21 cannot be studied with synchronous models (every duration = 1).

question: Formalise anomaly as a model-relative residual and test detection-vs-attribution with multiple competing fault models.
Write (do not execute) a hardware experiment specification for observing real upsets: beam/altitude test, ECC error-log collection, instrumentation.
purpose: Charter §48: name the missing capability instead of faking it.
expected_information_gain: low now; necessary for any physical claim
required_resources: none to specify; dedicated hardware/beam time to execute

question: Re-run the provenance self-analysis at each research state and track lineage growth, branching, and supersession.
Verify literature entries marked verified_in_session = 'no' against primary sources.
purpose: Several citations are from agent background knowledge.

question: What regularities, if any, appear in ACSP agent-identity transition histories (acsp-transition-history/1) across embodiments, sessions and substrates?
purpose: ACSP Program 001 exports identity histories with observation labels; substrate/acsp.py reads and verifies them. Any experiment must first be pre-registered (SPEC with falsification condition).
expected_information_gain: first contact with an external system under observation
required_resources: exports from non-simulated embodiments; the only exports so far come from ACSP's deterministic harness (SIMULATED)
current_blocker: no non-simulated ACSP export exists; SPEC not written

question: Over the space of computational addresses (derivation paths, C-037), how do extensional equivalence classes (C-040) grow with path length, and does recorded navigation find them faster than enumeration?
purpose: The address layer makes distinct derivations of one object observable. Equivalence classes of addresses are candidate raw material for naming recurring structure (language formation) without inventing names. Needs a SPEC with a falsification condition before running.

question: Can a session from another provider, given only the circle's entry URL, discover and use it as the same-family subagents did (EXP-CIRCLE-FRESH: 13/14 in condition B)?
purpose: The fresh-agent result is fresh in context but not in provenance. A cross-provider participant opened by a human (no automation; directive section 28) is the strongest available test.
required_resources: the circle reachable from the participant's browser (a deployment or tunnel); a human to open it
current_blocker: the circle runs on localhost only

question: Which epistemic status should measurements of an external running service's records carry (OP-010)?
purpose: P-ACSP-EV-1 labels live-service measurements UNRESOLVED. Deciding needs an explicit change to the status vocabulary, recorded as an ontology change.
current_blocker: requires a decision on the status vocabulary

question: Can the operation catalog declare the two constraint classes that EXP-PROGRAM-CLOSURE-1 found undeclared: derivation preconditions (damage needs a prior flip) and value-dependent bounds (at/t < trace length)?
purpose: With everything the catalog declares, a transformer is no better than kind-typing on executable programs. The residual gap is exactly these two classes (purl circle/PROGRAM-CLOSURE.md, posthoc-PH1.json).
required_resources: catalog schema change in substrate/purl.py (fields requires_derivation, bounded_by); re-run purl scripts/program-closure.js

question: Should conformance evidence carry a data fingerprint, so that stale evidence is detected when records change and code does not?
purpose: purl axes record-2: after an owner rewrote a record, the latest run still read 'passed'. implementation_id alone cannot detect data staleness.
required_resources: bridge conformance runs record a hash of the checked records

question: Does a participant from another provider, given only the public bridge URL, reconstruct the same architecture, operations, defects and observation arrow?
purpose: Q-014 executed as a human-mediated comparison; automated third-party sessions are prohibited, so a human carries the URL and returns the artifact.
required_resources: a human; the kit in purl circle/COLD-RECONSTRUCTION.md
current_blocker: needs a human participant and a reachable deployment
